name: Led Zeppelin

whyMatters.en: Formed in 1968 from The Yardbirds’ last Scandinavian dates as the New Yardbirds, then Led Zeppelin. Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham fixed album-led hard rock across nine studio LPs; estimated hundreds of millions sold worldwide before Bonham’s death ended the band in 1980.
whyMatters.zh: 1968 年承接 The Yardbirds 末次斯堪的纳维亚巡演，先称 New Yardbirds，再改名 Led Zeppelin。Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham 以九张录音室专辑确立以专辑为导向的 hard rock；全球销量估计数亿，1980 年 Bonham 去世后乐队解散。

note.en: Ostinato riff; modal color outside straight blues harmony.
note.zh: 固定音型 riff；非直白蓝调和声的调式色彩。

note.en: From Led Zeppelin II (US #1 over Abbey Road). Open riff and theremin/feedback middle section.
note.zh: 出自《Led Zeppelin II》（美榜冠军，压过《Abbey Road》）。开放 riff，中段含 theremin 与反馈。

note.en: From the untitled fourth album (often Led Zeppelin IV). Never issued as a single; long FM staple and album-rock reference.
note.zh: 出自未命名第四专（常称《Led Zeppelin IV》）。从未发单曲；长期 FM 点播与专辑导向摇滚参照。

note.en: From Physical Graffiti; repeating ostinato and orchestral arrangement on the heavier mid-1970s side.
note.zh: 出自《Physical Graffiti》；反复固定音型与管弦编曲，属 1970 年代中期偏重的一面。

note.en: Only Zeppelin studio track with a guest lead vocal: Sandy Denny (Fairport Convention) with Plant.
note.zh: 唯一有嘉宾主唱的录音室曲：Sandy Denny（Fairport Convention）与 Plant 对唱。

interviewQuotes.text: I can't put a label on our music. I hope someone invents a word.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jimmy Page

interviewQuotes.text: Our albums were written on the road. Whenever we had a few hours between shows, we booked a studio.
interviewQuotes.speaker: John Paul Jones

interviewQuotes.text: We were in particularly high spirits. The vibe was really good.
interviewQuotes.speaker: John Paul Jones

shortBio.en: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham, 1968–1980. From New Yardbirds to album-led hard rock; Stairway to Heaven never a single.
shortBio.zh: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham，1968–1980。由 New Yardbirds 到以专辑为导向的 hard rock；《Stairway to Heaven》从未发单曲。

body.en:
Jimmy Page had played in The Yardbirds since 1966. When that band collapsed on the eve of a 1968 Scandinavian tour, Page recruited Robert Plant and John Bonham from Band of Joy, plus session bassist John Paul Jones, as the New Yardbirds. After Chris Dreja’s name threat, they became Led Zeppelin and cut the debut at Olympic Studios in Barnes. First show: 7 September 1968, Gladsaxe, Denmark.

Led Zeppelin (1969) entered UK and US Top 10s. Led Zeppelin II topped the US chart over The Beatles’ Abbey Road. Led Zeppelin III (1970) leaned folk and blues in a Welsh village; the untitled fourth album (1971) balanced both and later sold over 20 million in the US alone, with Black Dog, Rock and Roll, and Stairway to Heaven. Houses of the Holy (1973), Physical Graffiti (1975), Presence (1976), and In Through the Out Door (1979) followed. Bonham died in September 1980 during rehearsals; the band dissolved rather than replace him. Coda (1982) collected leftovers. Later Page/Plant, Coverdale·Page, and Jones projects (including Them Crooked Vultures with Dave Grohl and Josh Homme) stayed separate from a full reunion—aside from Live Aid 1985, Atlantic’s 40th, and the 2007 O2 show with Jason Bonham.
body.zh:
Jimmy Page 自 1966 年起在 The Yardbirds 演奏。1968 年斯堪的纳维亚巡演售票前夕乐队解散，Page 从 Band of Joy 召入 Robert Plant、John Bonham，加上录音室贝斯手 John Paul Jones，组成 New Yardbirds。因 Chris Dreja 姓名诉讼威胁改名 Led Zeppelin，并在 Barnes 的 Olympic Studios 录首专。首演：1968 年 9 月 7 日，丹麦格拉德萨克斯。

《Led Zeppelin》（1969）进入英、美榜前 10。《Led Zeppelin II》美榜冠军，压过 The Beatles《Abbey Road》。《Led Zeppelin III》（1970）在威尔士偏僻村庄创作，民谣与蓝调各半；未命名第四专（1971）平衡两者，仅美国后来逾 2000 万张，含《Black Dog》《Rock and Roll》《Stairway to Heaven》。之后有《Houses of the Holy》（1973）、《Physical Graffiti》（1975）、《Presence》（1976）、《In Through the Out Door》（1979）。1980 年 9 月 Bonham 在彩排期间去世，乐队选择解散而非替换。精选未发表曲的《Coda》于 1982 年发行。后来的 Page/Plant、Coverdale·Page，以及 Jones 与 Dave Grohl、Josh Homme 的 Them Crooked Vultures 等均非完整重组——除 1985 Live Aid、Atlantic 40 周年，以及 2007 年 O2 体育场 Jason Bonham 司鼓那场。

title.en: From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin
title.zh: 从 The Yardbirds 到 Led Zeppelin

body.en:
Page inherited The Yardbirds’ Scandinavian dates and rebuilt the lineup as New Yardbirds: Plant and Bonham from Band of Joy, Jones from session work.

Chris Dreja’s legal threat forced the Led Zeppelin rename before the Olympic Studios debut sessions.

That Yardbirds continuity is why Page’s guitar and production sit at the center of the early catalog.
body.zh:
Page 承接 The Yardbirds 的斯堪的纳维亚档期，以 New Yardbirds 重组：Plant、Bonham 来自 Band of Joy，Jones 来自录音室工作。

Chris Dreja 的法律威胁迫使在 Olympic Studios 首专录音前改名 Led Zeppelin。

这条 Yardbirds 延续线，使 Page 的吉他与制作居于早期曲目中心。

alt.en: Led Zeppelin promotional photo, 1971 — Jones, Page, Bonham, Plant

title.en: Album rock and hard rock labels
title.zh: 专辑摇滚与 hard rock 标签

body.en:
Page refused a single genre label in early press, calling the music close to contemporary blues. Hard rock and heavy metal both fit later descriptions; Plant resisted the metal tag.

Eight of nine studio albums sold over a million copies in multiple countries. The untitled fourth album ranks among the highest-selling US albums; Stairway to Heaven became the band’s calling card without a single release.

Jones’s remark about writing between tour dates matches the on-the-road studio habit.
body.zh:
Page 早期采访拒绝单一类型标签，称接近当代蓝调。后来 hard rock 与 heavy metal 都适用；Plant 抵制金属标签。

九张录音室专辑中有八张在多国销量逾百万。未命名第四专跻身美国史上销量最高专辑之列；《Stairway to Heaven》成为名片却从未发单曲。

Jones 关于巡演间隙写歌的说法，对应路上订录音室的习惯。

title.en: Houses of the Holy to In Through the Out Door
title.zh: Houses of the Holy 到 In Through the Out Door

body.en:
Houses of the Holy (1973) is lighter in tone; Physical Graffiti (1975) and Presence (1976) push darker weight. Page’s heroin use and the 1977 death of Plant’s son Karac mark the personal cost of the decade.

In Through the Out Door (1979) was the last studio album before Bonham’s death during 1980 rehearsals. The remaining members dissolved the band rather than continue without him.
body.zh:
《Houses of the Holy》（1973）语气较轻；《Physical Graffiti》（1975）与《Presence》（1976）偏重、偏暗。Page 的海洛因依赖与 1977 年 Plant 六岁儿子 Karac 去世，是这十年的个人代价。

《In Through the Out Door》（1979）是 Bonham 1980 年彩排去世前最后一张录音室专辑。其余成员选择解散，而非无他继续。

alt.en: Led Zeppelin live in Chicago, January 1975
alt.zh: Led Zeppelin 芝加哥现场，1975 年 1 月

body.en:
Acoustic opening into layered guitars, Bonham’s entry, and a closing solo section on the fourth album.

Never a commercial single; FM radio made the long form a frequent request and a model for album-oriented rock programming.
body.zh:
第四专上：原声开场、多层吉他、Bonham 进入，收束于独奏段。

非商业单曲；FM 电台使这首长曲成为常见点播，也是专辑导向摇滚排片的参照。

body.en:
Plant’s solo albums Pictures at Eleven and The Principle of Moments reached US Top 10. Page scored Death Wish II, formed The Firm with Paul Rodgers, and later Coverdale·Page with David Coverdale (Whitesnake).

Page and Plant released No Quarter (1993) and Walking into Clarksdale (1998). Jones worked with Diamanda Galás, Butthole Surfers, R.E.M., and Them Crooked Vultures.

The 2007 O2 reunion with Jason Bonham was widely praised; Plant declined a permanent reboot. Page, Jones, and Bonham rehearsed with Steven Tyler and Myles Kennedy but did not tour that lineup.
body.zh:
Plant 个人专辑《Pictures at Eleven》《The Principle of Moments》进入美榜前 10。Page 为《死亡愿望 II》配乐，与 Paul Rodgers 组 The Firm，后又与 Whitesnake 的 David Coverdale 做 Coverdale·Page。

Page 与 Plant 发行《No Quarter》（1993）、《Walking into Clarksdale》（1998）。Jones 合作过 Diamanda Galás、Butthole Surfers、R.E.M.，以及 Them Crooked Vultures。

2007 年 O2 重聚（Jason Bonham 司鼓）评价很高；Plant 拒绝永久重组。Page、Jones、Bonham 曾与 Steven Tyler、Myles Kennedy 彩排，但未以该编制巡演。

alt.en: Robert Plant and Jimmy Page on stage, Chicago 1977
alt.zh: Robert Plant 与 Jimmy Page 舞台照，芝加哥 1977

note.en: Only studio lineup. New Yardbirds → Led Zeppelin; ended after Bonham’s death.
note.zh: 唯一录音室阵容。New Yardbirds → Led Zeppelin；Bonham 去世后结束。

note.en: Led Zeppelin II US #1 single-era track; riff plus studio middle section.
note.zh: 《Led Zeppelin II》美榜时期代表曲；riff 加录音室中段。

note.en: Yardbirds continuity into album-led hard rock; blues and folk forms expanded for arena scale.
note.zh: Yardbirds 延续到以专辑为导向的 hard rock；蓝调与民谣形式扩展到体育场规模。
